title: Setup: run eclipse-collections #1786's landed map tests on the parent revision
description: Setup for case R01 of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-r01-r50-brief.md, no claims. eclipse-collections PR #1786 moves the value computation in UnifiedMap and UnifiedMapWithHashingStrategy updateValue/updateValueWith before the key is published, and adds assertions to five test files (MutableMapIterableTestCase in unit-tests and unit-tests-java8, UnmodifiableBiMapTest, UnmodifiableMutableMapTest, UnmodifiableTreeMapTest). In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-r01-r50 (Maven local repository resolved there already, JDK 17, offline, settings maven-settings-ec.xml which mirrors the 503-ing repo.eclipse.org plugin repository to Maven Central), at the parent pin 3b3c55a47406ca11ece6c077b96c9564f73dfc53: runs the parent's own map and bimap tests (all *Test classes under impl/map, impl/bimap, test/map, test/bimap; about 120,000 tests, about 2 minutes), keeps the parent jars and class digests, then runs the same tests on a copy of the parent with the fix's five test files, where the new throwing-callback assertions are expected to fail. The fix side (4af700cda608e6817d7d17ab340b91442278cf14) ran inline: 120,694 tests, 0 failures. Each run recompiles the modules, so the runs are a job.
expected: every step exits 0: the parent's own tests pass; the landed step prints LANDED-TESTS-FAIL-ON-PARENT-AS-EXPECTED and names the failing tests; the copy and build output are removed
